thought.text: Build still running (it's a large project). Let me install RabbitMQ 4.x in the meantime:

reasoning_content: The build is still starting up. Let's install RabbitMQ from the official repository while the build continues.

action.command:
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
curl -fsSL https://packages.rabbitmq.com/rabbitmq/signing-key.asc | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/rabbitmq.gpg 2>/dev/null
echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/rabbitmq.gpg] https://packages.rabbitmq.com/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server/v4.0/x86_64/ jammy/" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/rabbitmq.list
apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -1
apt-cache policy rabbitmq-server | head -4
